list.title: Runs
list.description: Every agent run, with its steps, tools and cost.
list.empty: No runs yet. They show up when you talk to an agent or a task or schedule starts. <link>Open chat</link>
list.emptyFiltered: No runs match these filters. <link>Reset filters</link>

actions.cancelDescription: The run stops now and does not continue. This cannot be undone.

errors.onlyFailedRerun: Only failed runs can be run again
errors.noConversation: This run has no conversation to continue
errors.agentDeleted: The agent of this run was deleted

input.title: Input
input.noPrompt: continues the conversation, no new prompt
input.fromConversation: The run started from the existing conversation (a chat message or a continuation after an approval).

timeline.title: Timeline
timeline.emptyActive: Steps show up here as the agent works.
timeline.emptyDone: The run recorded no steps, fallbacks or errors.

links.none: This run is not linked to a task or conversation.

timeline.emptyStep: Step with no text or tools.
timeline.fallbackExhausted: {from} failed and there is no other model in the chain

lifecycle.unqueued: The run never started: its job is no longer in the queue
lifecycle.overdue: The run went past its time limit and was stopped
